name: progressbar
description: A widget reporting the progress of a task that takes a long time and ends. APG has no pattern page for it -- confirmed against the pattern index, not assumed -- so ARIA 1.2's role reference is the pattern's source instead, as status and textbox already do. APG's Meter pattern is deliberately NOT the source: meter is a gauge reading a static measurement inside a known range, where progressbar reports work under way. Unlike status, this role carries no implicit live region, so politeness must be set explicitly or value changes are not announced at all.

requires.roles.label: an accessible name is required, from aria-label or aria-labelledby
requires.live.politeness: an explicit aria-live, because the role carries none implicitly
requires.states.valuenow: aria-valuenow set when the widget reports a determinate value, and absent when it does not -- ARIA expresses indeterminacy by omitting it
requires.states.valuemin: aria-valuemin set when the widget reports a determinate value
requires.states.valuemax: aria-valuemax set when the widget reports a determinate value
